t: The Signature Vision: Interstellar Ark Fleets
title: The Signature Vision: Interstellar Ark Fleets
definition: The JAH-original Signature vision of Interstellar Ark Fleets.
description:

Signature ark hulls program, charter one: master gene banks at laboratory scale within the decade. Charter two: scale fleet propulsion manufacturing until cost collapses. Charter three: operate convoy coordination systems continuously, learning in public, improving every cycle.

This is a Signature concept — original JAH speculation, fully specified and honestly labeled. The public edition of this database carries the documented research record; this edition carries the bolder integrated vision: what Interstellar Ark Fleets becomes when every piece is designed to work with every other piece from day one.

t: 2032 — First long-duration ecological payloads testbed runs a sealed ar
title: 2032 — First long-duration ecological payloads testbed runs a sealed ar
definition: 2032 milestone on the Interstellar Ark Fleets roadmap.
description:
First long-duration ecological payloads testbed runs a sealed ark hulls habitat for 1,000 days on Earth, proving the gene banks recycling math.

What must be true first: the gene banks results have to replicate outside the lab, fleet propulsion manufacturing must reach pilot scale, and convoy coordination operations need a year of continuous runtime. Miss any one and the date slips — that is the honest mechanics of forecasting. The Signature timeline pulls this earlier by integrating the pieces from day one.

Signals to watch: peer-reviewed gene banks demonstrations, fleet propulsion cost curves bending down, and operators — not vendors — reporting convoy coordination uptime. When all three flash green, 2032 stops being a forecast and starts being a schedule. (6 years from the 2026 baseline.)

title: Readiness Estimator: Interstellar Ark Fleets
definition: Estimates Interstellar Ark Fleets readiness from component maturity.
description:
The estimator scores the six Interstellar Ark Fleets components on the TRL 1–9 scale and averages them into a verdict: research phase, pilot phase, or deployment phase. Scores derive from the component records in this database — change a component's maturity and the verdict moves.

Honest scoring is the point: a ark hulls that averages TRL 3 is not failing, it is three phases from deployment, and the estimator tells you which component drags the average down. Fund that one first.

title: Interstellar Ark Fleets Systems Simulator
definition: Simulates Interstellar Ark Fleets operating for a day.
description:
The simulator walks a Interstellar Ark Fleets installation through six operating steps, with seeded randomness standing in for real-world variation. Seed 53769 reproduces this exact run — change the seed in the program to explore other days.

Watch for DEGRADED steps: they mark where gene banks monitoring, fleet propulsion redundancy, or convoy coordination maintenance would intervene in a real deployment. A simulator that never degrades is lying; this one degrades about eight percent of the time, like early hardware does.

title: Interstellar Ark Fleets Master Roadmap
definition: The united roadmap for Interstellar Ark Fleets: prove, build, operate, compound.
description:
The master roadmap for Interstellar Ark Fleets — fleets of arks carrying species, seeds and cultures outward.

Phase 1 — Prove (gene banks): laboratory demonstrations of every component, replicated independently. No scaling until the physics is boring.

Phase 2 — Build (fleet propulsion): pilot manufacturing and integration. The six pieces meet for the first time and the interfaces get honest.

Phase 3 — Operate (convoy coordination): continuous real-world operation. Uptime, cost curves and failure data replace projections.

Phase 4 — Compound (ecological payloads): ark hulls as everyday infrastructure. Costs collapse, standards settle, and deep-space-scale deployment begins.

Signature edition: phases overlap aggressively — integration starts on day one. This record unites the database: overview, research, components, milestones, demos and drills all point here.

Each phase has exit criteria.
Unites all 20 records.
